description: After an untold number of world-hopping adventures and endless acts of derring-do, Tilith had to admit she was past due for a well-deserved break. Even the guardian goddess of humanity needs to recharge! And so it was that Tilith poured all her heart and soul into a wish—and this time, something answered.Normally, such tales end in comical disaster at best and terrible tragedy at worst, but not for one so pure of heart and sincere intention. Following the burst of light and sound, the gentle caress of sunlight greeted the goddess, and an endless expanse of golden sand stretched out before her.This was it. This was the fabled Starfall Island she had wanted to visit with her Summoner! Though most would rightly question the exact details of how—and more importantly, why—one could so easily teleport to a destination seen only in the mind's eye, Tilith felt only bliss in that moment; not to mention an overwhelming desire to jump for joy. Legend has it that stars landed on the island to rest, and the stardust left in their wake seeped into the beaches, giving rise to the aptly named "starsand." Unsurprisingly, this has given rise to the idea that the island brims with wish-granting magics.Soon, Tilith found other people on the island, no doubt here as part of an out-of-season holiday destination. With so many things to do, Tilith set off exploring. Memories are all the sweeter when experienced with friends, whether old or new! Surely there must be many, many memories waiting to be made on this island, and best of all, with her beloved Legendary Summoner...
summon: We're here at last!Finally, a holiday by the beach!I'm so happy I could cry!
fusion: Mmm~ That really hit the spot!How about another round?
evolution: Oh! Did you see that?Quick! Take my hand, and let's make a wish!
